context: Processed meats and risk of childhood leukemia (California, USA). The relation between the intake of certain food items thought to be precursors or inhibitors of N-nitroso compounds (NOC) and risk of leukemia was investigated in a case-control study among children from birth to age 10 years in Los Angeles County, California (United States).
target: Cases were ascertained through a population-based tumor registry from 1980 to 1987.
